### 3.1 首屏

**眉题**：CUSTOM BUSINESS SIGNAGE

**H1**：Custom Signs, Made for Your Business

Bring your logo, lettering or reference idea to life. Explore illuminated signs, dimensional letters and custom finishes, then talk with us about the right approach for your project.

**主按钮**：Get a Custom Quote

**次按钮**：Explore Our Work

**辅助文案**：Not sure about the size or style? Start with your idea or a reference photo.

### 3.2 产品分类

**标题**：Find the Right Look for Your Sign

Start with the effect you want. We’ll help clarify the materials, construction and details during your project discussion.

| 分类标题 | 卡片文案 |
| --- | --- |
| LED Channel Letters | Illuminated lettering with a bright, clearly defined face. |
| Backlit & Halo Lit Letters | Light behind the letters creates a glow across the mounting surface. |
| Metal & Dimensional Letters | Raised lettering with a choice of metal looks and surface finishes. |
| Acrylic Letters & Signs | Custom lettering and layered signs with acrylic finishes. |
| Lightboxes & Neon-style Signs | Illuminated panels and line-based lighting for a different visual effect. |
| Specialty Custom Signs | Explore distinctive finishes, lighting effects and fabrication details. |

**卡片入口**：Explore This Style

### 3.3 精选作品

**标题**：See the Details. Picture Your Project.

Explore selected signs, samples and project work. Look at the lighting, finish and construction to find a direction for your own sign.

**按钮**：View All Work

实施说明：卡片必须显示真实类型：Project、Finished Sign、Sample 或 Design Concept。

### 3.4 可定制内容

**标题**：Your Logo. Your Lettering. Your Project.

Each enquiry starts with what you need the sign to do and where it will be used.

**Logo & Lettering**

Share your logo, business name or reference design.

**Size & Layout**

Tell us the available space or your approximate dimensions.

**Materials & Finishes**

Discuss the appearance, colours and surface details you have in mind.

**Lighting & Construction**

Explore illuminated and non-illuminated options, subject to the project requirements.

**按钮**：Discuss My Sign

### 3.5 定制流程

**标题**：From Your Idea to a Confirmed Sign Specification

**1. Share Your Project**

Start with your intended use, delivery country and preferred style.

**2. Confirm the Details**

Continue on WhatsApp to discuss artwork, dimensions, materials and delivery requirements.

**3. Review Your Quote**

Receive a project-based quote with the agreed specifications and scope.

**4. Production & Delivery**

Once the order and production details are confirmed, fabrication, checks and shipping follow the agreed arrangements.

**按钮**：See How It Works

### 3.6 制作与交付证明

**标题**：Look Beyond the Finished Face

The finish matters. So do the construction, lighting details, checks and packaging behind it. We work with manufacturing partners and confirm these details for each order.

**图片说明**：Surface & Edge Details / Lighting Checks / Construction Details / Packing Preparation

**按钮**：About Our Supply Process

实施说明：标题应对应真实图片；没有的环节暂不展示。

### 3.7 双客户入口

**标题**：Signs for Your Business—or Your Customer’s Project

**For Business Owners**

Looking for signage for a shop, office or commercial space? Start with your logo or the look you want.

**按钮**：Discuss My Business Sign

**For Sign Companies & Installers**

Need fabrication support for a customer project? Share your drawings, specifications or sourcing requirements.

**按钮**：Explore Supply Cooperation

### 3.8 首页 FAQ

**Can I start without final dimensions?**

Yes. Share the intended location and any approximate measurements you have. Final dimensions will need to be confirmed before production.

**Can you work from my logo?**

Send your logo on WhatsApp so we can review the artwork and discuss how it could be made into a sign.

**How much will my sign cost?**

Pricing depends on the design, dimensions, materials, lighting, quantity and delivery requirements. We quote after reviewing your project.

**Can you ship to my country?**

Tell us the destination country and city. We’ll confirm the available shipping arrangements as part of the enquiry.

**Who handles installation?**

Installation arrangements must be confirmed for your project. Please tell us whether you have a local installer and what support or documentation they require.

### 3.9 底部转化

**标题**：Have a Sign in Mind?

Share a few details, then continue on WhatsApp to discuss your project and quote.

**按钮**：Get a Custom Quote

统一结构：首屏 → 图片与细节 → 定制方向 → 相关作品 → FAQ → 询价。相关作品只引用已核实内容，不编造关联。

### 5.1 LED 发光字

**H1**：Custom LED Channel Letters

Give your business name or logo an illuminated presence. Share the look you want, and we’ll review the letter construction, face material and lighting requirements for your project.

**按钮**：Get a Quote for LED Letters

**图片区标题**：Explore the Face, Edges and Lighting

View examples of illuminated lettering and construction details. The final appearance depends on the selected materials, letter size and lighting arrangement.

**定制区标题**：Built Around Your Lettering

Discuss your logo or font, overall dimensions, face colour, side finish, lighting colour and mounting requirements.

**应用区标题**：Plan for the Installation Location

Tell us where the letters will be used, the mounting surface and whether the location is indoors or outdoors. These details help define what must be reviewed before quoting.

**Are these letters suitable for outdoor use?**

Outdoor suitability must be confirmed for the specific construction, electrical components and installation conditions.

**Can you match my brand colours?**

Share your colour references. Available finishes and the appearance when illuminated need to be reviewed before confirmation.

**结尾标题**：Looking for This Style in Your Own Logo?

Send us your project details and continue the discussion on WhatsApp.

**按钮**：Discuss My LED Sign

### 5.2 背发光字

**H1**：Custom Backlit & Halo Lit Letters

Create a glow behind your logo or lettering. Explore backlit sign examples, then discuss the finish, lighting and mounting arrangement for your space.

**按钮**：Get a Quote for Backlit Letters

**效果区标题**：The Light Behind the Letters

Backlighting creates an illuminated outline on the surface behind the sign. The result is influenced by the letter shape, wall colour, surface texture and distance from the wall.

**定制区标题**：Choose the Finish. Review the Glow.

Discuss metal or other available face finishes, lettering dimensions, light colour and mounting details. Materials and construction are confirmed against the selected design.

**准备资料标题**：Show Us Where It Will Go

A photo of the installation area can help us understand the background and layout. Approximate dimensions are enough to begin the conversation.

**Will the glow look exactly like the reference photo?**

The surrounding light, wall surface and installation spacing affect the appearance. Reference images show a direction; the final setup needs project-specific review.

**结尾标题**：Explore a Backlit Version of Your Logo

**按钮**：Discuss My Backlit Sign

### 5.3 金属立体字

**H1**：Custom Metal & Dimensional Letters

Give your logo depth through raised lettering and considered surface details. Explore metal lettering examples and discuss the finish and construction that suit your project.

**按钮**：Get a Quote for Metal Letters

**细节区标题**：A Closer Look at the Finish

Compare examples of brushed, polished, painted and plated appearances. Available materials and finish processes depend on the design and intended use.

**定制区标题**：Define the Shape and Depth

Share your artwork, dimensions, preferred depth, surface appearance and mounting needs. We’ll review the fabrication approach before confirming the specification.

**说明标题**：Illuminated or Non-illuminated?

Metal lettering can involve different constructions. Tell us whether you want a non-illuminated sign or a lighting effect so the right options can be reviewed.

**Can I choose a metallic colour from a photo?**

A reference photo is a useful starting point. For an exact finish requirement, we’ll need to confirm the available process and how the finish will be approved.

**结尾标题**：Let’s Review Your Metal Lettering Project

**按钮**：Discuss My Metal Letters

### 5.4 亚克力字与标识

**H1**：Custom Acrylic Letters & Signs

Explore acrylic lettering, logo shapes and layered sign designs. Share the colour, depth and overall appearance you have in mind.

**按钮**：Get a Quote for Acrylic Signs

**细节区标题**：Colour, Depth and Layering

Acrylic can be used in different lettering and sign constructions. View the examples to compare material appearance, edge details and layered effects.

**定制区标题**：Start with Your Artwork

Discuss cut shapes, dimensions, material colour, thickness, layers and fixing requirements. Availability and suitability are confirmed for each design.

**Are acrylic letters always illuminated?**

No. Acrylic may be used in non-illuminated lettering or as part of an illuminated construction. Tell us which effect you want.

**结尾标题**：Have an Acrylic Logo Sign in Mind?

**按钮**：Discuss My Acrylic Sign

### 5.5 灯箱与霓虹效果招牌

**H1**：Custom Lightboxes & Neon-style Signs

Explore illuminated sign faces and line-based lighting effects. Choose the direction you like, then discuss the construction and details for your project.

**按钮**：Get a Quote for This Style

**Lightbox Signs**

Explore examples with an illuminated face or panel. Share the overall shape, artwork, dimensions and intended location so the sign construction can be reviewed.

**Neon-style Signs**

Explore illuminated lines, lettering and graphic shapes. The light source, backing and construction must be confirmed for the selected product.

**重要说明**：“Neon-style” describes the visual direction on this page. Confirm the actual light source and materials with us before ordering.

**Can you make my logo in this style?**

Send the artwork for review. Fine details, line spacing and the required size may affect how the design can be produced.

**结尾标题**：Which Lighting Effect Fits Your Idea?

**按钮**：Discuss My Lightbox or Neon-style Sign

### 5.6 特殊定制招牌

**H1**：Specialty Custom Signs

Have a sign idea that goes beyond a standard look? Share the effect, finish or construction you are trying to achieve.

**按钮**：Discuss a Custom Fabrication Project

**展示区标题**：Explore Different Fabrication Directions

Selected examples may include exposed-light effects, compact lettering, colour-changing illumination and distinctive surface treatments. Each option requires its own specification review.

实施说明：仅展示已核实的具体工艺。

**定制区标题**：Bring the Reference. Let’s Review the Details.

Send a sketch, artwork or reference image. We’ll discuss what can be produced, what needs further checking and which details are required for a quote.

**Can you reproduce a sign from a photo?**

A photo helps explain the appearance you want, but may not show its materials or construction. We’ll need to clarify those details rather than assume an exact match.

**结尾标题**：Tell Us What You’re Trying to Make

**按钮**：Start My Project Enquiry

sections.9:
**H1**：How Your Custom Sign Project Works

Start with what you know. We’ll clarify the remaining details with you before confirming a quote and production specification.

**Step 1 — Tell Us About the Project**

Share the intended use, delivery country and preferred sign style. A logo, reference photo or initial idea is enough to start the discussion.

**Step 2 — Review the Design & Requirements**

Continue on WhatsApp to discuss dimensions, artwork, materials, lighting, quantities and the installation location. We’ll identify what still needs to be confirmed.

**Step 3 — Review Your Project Quote**

Your quote is based on the agreed information. Check the specifications, included costs, delivery arrangements and any assumptions or exclusions before proceeding.

**Step 4 — Confirm the Order & Production Details**

Artwork, dimensions, finishes, commercial terms and the approval process must be confirmed before production is authorised.

**Step 5 — Fabrication, Checks & Packing**

Production and checks follow the confirmed order requirements. Any agreed inspection records or packing requirements should be included in the project scope.

**Step 6 — Shipping & Installation Preparation**

Shipping arrangements are confirmed for the destination. Local installation responsibilities and any required support documents should be agreed before dispatch.

**Useful to Have, but Not Required to Start**

- Your logo or reference image
- Approximate dimensions
- Indoor or outdoor location
- Quantity
- Delivery country and city
- Preferred delivery timing

**辅助说明**：Missing some details? Tell us what is still undecided.

**按钮**：Start My Enquiry

policies.title: Privacy Notice
policies.body:
Canonical route: `/privacy/`

Last updated: [Publication date]

### 1. Who is responsible for your information?

Custom Sign Forge is a trading name of [Full legal operator name], based at [Business address and country/region]. This operator is responsible for the personal information described in this notice.

Contact: [Privacy email]. Business contact details are also available on our Business Information page.

[REVIEW: Confirm controller identity, operating location and any required EEA/UK representative or data protection officer details. Add applicable regional disclosures before targeting those markets.]

### 2. Information we handle

You must sign in before filling in or submitting the website enquiry form. Customer sign-in uses Google or a one-time email code. We store your verified email, customer account identifier and, if used, a Google account identifier to provide your account and associate your enquiries. Customer accounts and administrator access are separate. You can view only enquiries associated with your customer account.

When you submit a website enquiry, we receive the sign style, intended use, delivery country and project stage you provide. You may also provide your role, city, preferred timing and short comments. We create an enquiry reference and associate the enquiry with relevant product, example or entry-page details.

Where available and permitted, we may record campaign and referral information associated with your visit or enquiry. We do not assume a source where it cannot be established.

Our website and security providers process technical information needed to deliver and protect the service, such as network, browser, request and security signals. The actual tools and device-storage technologies are described in our Cookie Notice.

If you contact us through WhatsApp or email, we receive the contact information, messages and files you choose to send there. We may maintain necessary project notes, quotation and order records. WhatsApp conversations are not automatically imported into this website's enquiry database.

Please do not include identity documents, payment-card details or unrelated sensitive personal information in an enquiry. You do not need to provide a budget, company name, telephone number or production drawing in the website form.

### 3. Why we use information

We use relevant information to respond to enquiries, clarify requirements, prepare quotations, coordinate confirmed projects and provide support. We also use limited records to protect the website, manage enquiries and understand permitted source and performance information.

Submitting an enquiry does not subscribe you to promotional messages. Any separate marketing activity must have an appropriate basis and an available way to stop it.

[REVIEW: Insert the approved purpose-by-purpose lawful-basis table where required. Distinguish steps requested by an individual before a contract, business-contact legitimate interests where appropriate, legal obligations, security interests and consent for relevant optional activities. Identify the specific interests and complete assessments before relying on them.]

### 4. WhatsApp and external links

Choosing WhatsApp takes you to a separate service. A prepared message may contain your selected style, use, destination country, project stage, reference example and enquiry reference. You can review and edit it before sending. Opening the link does not send a message automatically.

WhatsApp's own privacy terms apply to its service. We remain responsible for our handling of the information we receive. If you prefer another contact method, email [Business email].

[REVIEW: Link the relevant regional WhatsApp policy and confirm the actual click-to-chat implementation. Do not send full enquiry text or prepared-message URLs to analytics tools.]

### 5. Who may receive information

We use technical providers for hosting, database and file storage, security, administrator access and business communications. Where needed for your project, we may share relevant specifications with manufacturing partners and necessary fulfilment information with logistics or related service providers.

We limit sharing to what is needed for the purpose. Customer artwork is not automatically made public or included in our marketing.

Current technical services include Cloudflare Workers (hosting), D1 (website records), R2 (promotional media), Turnstile (enquiry security) and Cloudflare email sending for authorised administrator sign-in. Domain business email is handled through our existing mail system. Optional first-party event analytics are stored in D1 only after your choice. WhatsApp is an external contact service. Google is used when you choose Google sign-in; we request identity and email information only, not access to your Gmail messages or files. Cloudflare email sending is also used for requested customer sign-in codes. External analytics and advertising trackers remain disabled. See [Google's Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy).

[REVIEW: Confirm provider contracts, manufacturing and fulfilment recipient categories, any applicable sale/sharing analysis and regional disclosures before the policy is approved.]

### 6. International processing

Information may be accessed or processed in [Actual countries/regions] by us and our providers. Where applicable law requires protection for international transfers, we use [Verified mechanism and safeguards]. You can contact [Privacy email] for relevant information or a copy of applicable safeguards, subject to lawful redaction.

[REVIEW: Complete actual locations, remote access and safeguards; a provider contract alone is not a completed transfer assessment.]

### 7. How long information is kept

We keep information only for the relevant purpose and applicable legal requirements. Our retention rules are:

| Record | Retention period or criteria |
| --- | --- |
| Customer account and account-linked enquiry records | [Approved period, account closure and applicable order-retention criteria] |
| Enquiries without established contact | [Approved period and starting point] |
| Active enquiries and project communication | [Approved period or clear criteria] |
| Orders, financial and dispute records | [Applicable obligations and periods] |
| Security and technical logs | [Approved period and incident exceptions] |
| Optional first-party analytics events | Scheduled deletion after 90 days |
| Privacy choices on your device | Valid for 180 days; browser storage remains until replaced or cleared |
| Optional first-source attribution on your device | Up to 90 days of use; removed on withdrawal |
| Backups | [Rotation and deletion period] |

When a record is no longer needed, we delete it or make it no longer identifiable, subject to applicable retention requirements. Backup deletion follows the stated rotation process.

### 8. Your choices and rights

Depending on the law that applies, you may have rights to access, correct, delete or obtain a copy of your personal information, restrict processing or request portability. Some rights depend on the purpose and legal basis of the processing.

You may object to processing based on legitimate interests where applicable. You may also object to direct marketing. Where processing is based on consent, you can withdraw it without affecting the lawfulness of earlier processing.

Contact [Privacy email] to make a request. We may ask for proportionate information to verify your identity. An enquiry reference alone does not authorise access to personal information.

You may complain to the relevant data protection authority. [Add applicable authority details; for UK individuals, include a link to the ICO where appropriate.]

For account or personal-data requests, contact the privacy email above. Deleting or correcting account data requires identity verification and consideration of any applicable order or legal retention duties; signing out alone does not delete an account.

Optional tracking choices can be managed through Cookie Settings. Declining optional tracking does not prevent you from browsing products or contacting us.

### 9. Security and automated decisions

We use appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect information. No method of transmission or storage can be guaranteed completely secure.

We do not use an AI score to decide whether to accept your project. Project suitability and quotation decisions are reviewed by people.

[REVIEW: Verify actual access controls, retention/deletion procedures and automated processing before publication.]

### 10. Changes

We may update this notice to reflect changes in our practices or requirements. The date above identifies the current version. Where required, we will provide additional notice or obtain a new choice before materially different processing begins.

policies.title: Website Terms
policies.body:
Canonical route: `/terms/`

Last updated: [Publication date]

### 1. About this website

This website is operated by [Full legal operator name], trading as Custom Sign Forge, at [Business address and country/region]. Contact [Business email] with questions about these terms.

The website provides information about custom signs and allows you to begin a project enquiry. It does not provide online checkout, an automatic final price or an online design service.

### 2. Customer accounts, enquiries and quotations

A verified customer account is required to fill in or submit a website enquiry. Sign in with Google or verify an email address you control. Keep access to that account secure, provide accurate project information and sign out on shared devices. Signing in does not provide administrator access or access to another customer's enquiries. Account enquiries can be reviewed in My Account; a saved record does not confirm that a quotation or order has been accepted.

Submitting an enquiry or opening WhatsApp does not place an order, reserve production capacity or confirm that a project has been accepted.

Specifications, price, currency, included costs, delivery arrangements, payment requirements and any production approval process must be agreed separately. The relevant quotation and order documents will identify the seller and applicable terms before you commit to an order.

### 3. Product information and examples

Images illustrate selected products, samples, concepts or project work as labelled. An example's dimensions or finish do not automatically become your order specification.

Screens, photography, surrounding light and installation conditions can affect appearance. Any finish samples, tolerances or approval references required for your order must be agreed before production. This does not excuse a failure to meet the agreed specification or mandatory legal requirements.

### 4. Artwork and information you provide

Only provide artwork, logos, drawings and other material you are entitled to share for the requested purpose. Tell us about any restrictions that affect review or production.

Providing material permits us to use and share it only as reasonably needed to review the enquiry and carry out agreed work, subject to applicable law and any agreed confidentiality terms. It does not transfer ownership to us or automatically permit public advertising use.

Do not send unlawful content, malicious files or unrelated personal information.

### 5. Website content and third-party names

Website text, images and designs are owned by us or used with appropriate permission, as applicable. Viewing the website does not grant permission to reuse them commercially. Nothing here limits uses permitted by applicable law.

Third-party names or logos shown in authorised examples do not, by themselves, imply endorsement or an ongoing partnership.

### 6. Manufacturing and project requirements

We coordinate with manufacturing partners. We do not describe a partner's factory as our own facility.

Product suitability, electrical requirements, required documents, mounting, local permissions and installation scope must be reviewed for the destination and project. No website image or general statement represents universal regulatory approval.

### 7. External services and acceptable use

WhatsApp and other external services have their own terms. Do not misuse this website, attempt unauthorised access, interfere with security or submit automated spam enquiries.

### 8. Liability and mandatory rights

Nothing in these terms excludes or restricts a right or liability that cannot lawfully be excluded or restricted. These website terms do not replace mandatory consumer rights or the terms properly agreed for a specific order.

[REVIEW: Determine whether any further balanced liability provisions are appropriate after the operator, markets and sales terms are confirmed. Do not add a blanket exclusion or an arbitrary liability cap.]

### 9. Questions, disputes and updates

Please contact [Support email] with the relevant enquiry or order reference so we can review a concern. This contact process does not remove any available statutory complaint or dispute route.

[REVIEW: Confirm governing law and dispute arrangements for the actual operator and markets, preserving mandatory protections. Do not publish an invented court or compulsory arbitration clause.]

Updated website terms apply prospectively as permitted by law. An update does not automatically rewrite a previously agreed order.

policies.title: Cookie Notice
policies.body:
Last updated: 18 October 2026

### 1. What this notice covers

This notice describes the website's current cookies, browser storage and security services. Our Privacy Notice explains related handling of enquiry and contact information. This technical description does not replace the remaining business and legal review.

### 2. Necessary functions

Customer sessions, administrator sessions, Google sign-in state and one-time email verification use first-party, HttpOnly cookies. Browsing products and references does not require registration. Filling in or submitting a website enquiry requires a verified customer account. Administrator access remains restricted to authorised staff. We also remember privacy choices on this device.

The enquiry form uses Cloudflare Turnstile to help prevent abuse. Cloudflare processes technical and security signals for this check. Turnstile is separate from optional website analytics. See [Cloudflare's Turnstile privacy information](https://www.cloudflare.com/turnstile-privacy-policy/).

### 3. Optional first-party analytics

Analytics are off until you choose Allow Analytics or enable Analytics in Cookie Settings. If allowed, we record page views, opening the enquiry page, successful enquiry saves, WhatsApp link clicks and direct-chat link clicks. We may associate these events with the public page, product or reference, button position and limited campaign tags. Clicks are not proof that a message was sent or received.

We do not include enquiry comments, contact details, enquiry reference numbers or full WhatsApp message links in these events. There are no visitor IDs, cross-site tracking cookies, advertising pixels, session recordings or automatic WhatsApp-message imports in this implementation. Events are stored in our Cloudflare-hosted website database and scheduled for deletion after 90 days. Campaign tags must not contain personal information.

No Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, Clarity or other external analytics or advertising scripts are enabled by this website.

### 4. Technology list

| Identifier | Provider/domain | Purpose | Category | Duration | Activation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| csf_customer | This website | Verified customer session and access to your own enquiries | Necessary | Up to 7 days; sign-out revokes the session | Successful customer sign-in |
| csf_customer_email | This website | Bind customer email verification to the requesting browser | Necessary | 10 minutes | Customer code request |
| csf_customer_oauth | This website | Validate Google customer sign-in state, nonce and PKCE | Necessary | Up to 10 minutes; cleared on successful callback | Choosing Google customer sign-in |
| csf_oauth | This website | Validate Google administrator sign-in state, nonce and PKCE | Necessary | Up to 10 minutes; cleared on successful callback | Choosing Google administrator sign-in |
| csf_admin | This website | Authorised administrator session | Necessary | Up to 8 hours; logout revokes the session | Successful administrator sign-in |
| csf_email | This website | Bind a one-time email sign-in attempt to the requesting browser | Necessary | 10 minutes | Email sign-in request |
| csf-cookie-preferences | This website, local storage | Remember privacy choices | Necessary preference | Choice valid for 180 days; browser storage remains until replaced or cleared | Saving a privacy choice |
| csf-first-source | This website, local storage | Remember the first permitted campaign source and entry page | Optional analytics | Up to 90 days of use, replaced on expiry; removed on withdrawal | Analytics allowed |
| csf-current-source | This website, session storage | Carry the current permitted campaign source between pages | Optional analytics | Current tab session; removed on withdrawal | Analytics allowed |
| Cloudflare Turnstile | challenges.cloudflare.com | Detect automated enquiry and customer code-request abuse | Security | Challenge and provider-controlled technical processing | Enquiry form security check |

Choosing Continue with Google takes you to Google for identity verification. Google processes its own sign-in cookies and security information under its [Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy). This website requests identity and email only. Google sign-in is not loaded automatically while browsing; your choice opens the sign-in service. Customer sign-in and account pages are excluded from our optional event analytics.

### 5. Your choices

Reject Optional and Allow Analytics are available on the initial notice. Cookie Settings in the footer lets you change your choice later. Rejecting or withdrawing stops future analytics requests and removes the campaign-source browser storage. Previously recorded events are not individually linked to a visitor and expire under the stated retention schedule.

Declining analytics does not prevent browsing, customer sign-in, submitting an enquiry from your verified account, emailing us or choosing WhatsApp. Campaign tags present in a submitted enquiry's URL can still be attached to that enquiry as part of handling it; they are separate from optional event tracking.

You can also clear browser storage using your browser controls. Blocking necessary functions may prevent administrator sign-in or the enquiry security check.

### 6. Questions

Contact [Privacy email] with questions about storage or privacy choices.

policies.title: Cancellations & Returns
policies.body:
Canonical route: `/cancellations-returns/`

Last updated: [Publication date]

### 1. Enquiries and custom orders

A website enquiry is not an order and does not require payment. This policy explains the framework for discussing changes, cancellations and product concerns after an order is separately agreed.

Custom signs are produced to confirmed project specifications. Your quotation and order documents will set out the applicable approval, production and payment arrangements before you commit.

### 2. Changes and cancellations

Contact [Support email] or your agreed project contact as soon as you want to change or cancel an order. Include the order reference and requested change. Do not assume a change is confirmed until we acknowledge it in writing.

Whether work can be stopped or changed depends on its actual stage, the agreed terms and applicable law. Any proposed effect on price, timing or cancellation costs must be explained and agreed where required.

[REVIEW: Insert approved commercial rules for pre-production work, approved artwork, materials already committed, production started, deposits and refunds. No default non-refundable percentage or charge is authorised by this draft.]

### 3. Personalised goods and mandatory rights

Where applicable law excludes genuinely personalised or made-to-specification goods from a change-of-mind cancellation right, that exclusion may apply to the relevant order. It does not remove rights relating to faulty goods, goods that do not match the agreed description or other non-excludable rights.

The treatment of a business purchase and a consumer purchase may differ. Applicable rights depend on the actual transaction and relevant law.

### 4. Faults, incorrect goods and damage

If you believe an item is faulty, incorrect or damaged, contact [Support email] with the order reference, a description and relevant photographs or video where reasonably available. Do not energise or install equipment that appears unsafe.

Please retain relevant packaging where reasonably possible so damage can be assessed. Reporting promptly can help with investigation and carrier claims; it is not intended to impose a shorter deadline than any mandatory right.

We will review the issue against the agreed specification and applicable obligations, and explain the available remedy. Depending on the circumstances and law, this may involve repair, replacement, a price adjustment or a refund. A remedy is not restricted to replacement where the law requires another option.

### 5. Return arrangements and refunds

Contact us for the correct return arrangements before shipping an item. A supplier or factory address shown elsewhere is not automatically a return address. This coordination request does not override statutory rights.

Responsibility for return or remedy costs and refund timing will be determined by applicable law and the properly agreed order terms.

[REVIEW: Add the verified return address/process, refund method and timing, cost allocation and any commercial warranty. State statutory rights separately from additional warranty benefits.]

### 6. Contact and complaints

Contact [Support email] or [Business contact details]. We will explain the next steps after reviewing the information. [Insert only a response-time commitment the business can actually meet.]

policies.title: Shipping & Installation
policies.body:
Canonical route: `/shipping-installation/`

Last updated: [Publication date]

### 1. Confirming the destination

Delivery availability is reviewed for each destination and product. Provide the country and city at the enquiry stage. We do not promise that every product can be supplied to every location.

### 2. Shipping scope and timing

Your quotation or order documents will identify the agreed shipping arrangement, included charges and relevant timing. Production time and transit time are different and should be checked separately.

Any delivery estimate must be understood alongside the agreed commitments and applicable rights. Tell us about a time-critical opening or installation date before confirming the order.

### 3. Import, duties and delivery responsibilities

The parties' responsibilities for export, import, customs clearance, duties, taxes, insurance and delivery must be stated in the order documents. Where a trade term is used, the named place and relevant version must be specified.

We do not assume that the customer is automatically responsible for every charge or risk. Mandatory legal responsibilities cannot be transferred simply by a general website statement.

### 4. Receiving your sign

Check the delivery and packaging when reasonably possible. Report apparent damage or missing items promptly and keep relevant evidence. Follow the Cancellations & Returns page if there is a problem. This guidance does not shorten mandatory claim rights.

### 5. Installation scope

On-site measurement, permits, structural work, electrical work and installation are included only where expressly agreed. Tell us about the mounting surface, location and local installer before the sign specification is finalised.

Electrical connection and mounting should be performed by appropriately qualified people in accordance with the applicable requirements and supplied instructions. Any drawings, mounting templates or technical support to be provided must be confirmed for the order.

### 6. Product requirements

Requirements depend on the destination, product configuration and intended use. Required labels, electrical details, documents and local approvals must be identified and reviewed before order acceptance.

A certificate or mark relating to one component does not establish approval of every finished sign. We do not claim universal certification or suitability.

If a required document or compliant configuration cannot be confirmed, we will need to clarify or change the scope before proceeding. No allocation of installation tasks removes obligations that cannot lawfully be excluded.

### 7. Contact

Discuss delivery and installation requirements through [Business email] or the agreed project contact.
